source: Central civil service pension rules as commonly applied; UPS notified by the Government of India in 2025; PFRDA exit rules. All values: verify with the employer or the state's notification.

OPS.basis: higher of last basic and average of last 10 months
OPS.dearness_relief: paid on the pension at the prevailing DA rate (indexed to inflation)

UPS.basis: average basic of the last 12 months
UPS.lump_sum: 1/10 of monthly basic + DA for each completed 6 months of service
